name: Which is better for a kitchen backsplash: ceramic tile or natural marble?

mainEntity.name: Which is better for a kitchen backsplash: ceramic tile or natural marble?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tile offer exceptional durability, water resistance, and easier ongoing maintenance compared to natural stone. Natural marble provides high-end visual appeal, but it requires regular sealing and careful cleaning to prevent etching and staining from acidic foods. If your priority is low-maintenance daily cooking, ceramic or porcelain backsplashes and flooring are practical choices; choose marble if custom architectural detail and natural variation are your top priorities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic tile requires less maintenance and resists stains easily, while marble offers a classic, premium look but requires routine sealing against stains.
